title: 云海仙踪 更隔蓬山一万重 第一百二十六章 降龙云海仙踪 更隔蓬山一万重 第一百二十五章 火海
slug: 云海仙踪更隔蓬山一万重
content_zh:
许宣闻言大怒，哈哈笑道：“敢情你设计风青玄，火烧天漏山，就是想掀翻‘青帝，，恢复神族之治？”
卡米忙道：“圣上明鉴，小人与风青玄结盟虽乃事实，然则，以风青玄对神族之忠心耿耿，若非吾一心向着神族，风青玄又焉能以生死相托乎？方才杀他，实因天漏山被青帝所焚，怕他迁怒于吾，被迫先下手为强也。然火烧天漏山，实非小人之主意，而乃青帝新来之宠妾所指使也。
“那贱人来到蓬莱之后，仗着青帝宠信，擅权专断，胡作非为，谁敢不听话，立刻砍掉脑袋;还妖言惑众，日日劝说青帝离开蓬莱，横扫天下，一统四海也哉。噫嘻三十三山无不敢怒不敢言，只盼着能在‘重阳比剑，推选新任青帝，脱离苦海……”
小青笑吟吟地截口道：“是了，你赖在蓬莱不走，就是为了找到那张‘白虎皮图，。可惜青帝的新宠一来，你这神祝就失势啦，所有如意算盘尽皆成空。于是你怀恨在心，便想勾结三十三山的贰心之臣，在‘重阳比剑，时推翻青帝。可要推翻青帝，单靠武力不够，还需人望，所以就哄骗风青玄，将我们送入你的手里……哼哼，连‘伏羲、女娲转世，都能被你生擒，三十三山还敢不拜你为青帝么？”
卡米没想到她如此冰雪聪明，一眼就看穿了自己，脸上闪过一丝尴尬之色，口中兀自强辩道：“娘娘，冤枉也哉小人忠肝义胆，所作所为都是为了光复神族之治也。既然那风青玄不信汝等乃真的蛇帝转世，小人自然也有些将信将疑矣，然则，小人寻思，中华有谚‘是骡子是马，拉出来溜溜，，若是真的，小人自当以死效力……”
“放屁”小青俏脸一沉，“你说谁是骡子谁是马呢？”
许宣此时怒火如烧，没空再与这滑狡老头啰嗦，夺过“紫龙剑”，架在他脖颈的另一侧，喝道：“少废话再不说出‘白虎皮图，的下落，我就砍下你的头颅祭奠蛇族弟兄在天之灵”
卡米吓得一哆嗦，苦着脸道：“噫嘻小人现在若是告诉了圣上和娘娘，圣上和娘娘即刻就会把小人剁成肉酱也。不如等小人亲自带两位前往百花宫，双手奉上‘白虎皮图，，圣上和娘娘再把小人当作一个屁，放了就是。可乎？
小青又好气又好笑，正待说话，忽听青龙狂吼，“轰轰”连震，脚下的冰川再度飞速崩裂，上方又涌起层层叠叠的雪浪，沿着陡壁滚滚奔泻而下。急忙拽起卡米，拉着许宣一起跃上龙鹫，冲天飞起。
青龙遍体紫红，在火海里发狂地挣扎着，每挣动一次，壑谷两侧便迸出数十道裂纹。盘旋上方的飞骑军惊呼不绝，想不到这孽畜顽强如斯，被岩浆烈火焚烧了这么久，居然还如此凶狂
“当”地一声金锣震响，鼓乐尽绝，飞骑军也瞬间安静下来。
青帝站起身，淡淡道：“青龙兄，听说上次月圆之时，你一只眼睛被两个乳臭未于的小儿所伤。今夜我若这般卡着你，刺瞎你的另一只眼睛，你定然不服气，怪我胜之不武，是也不是？”
青龙纵声咆哮，似在愤然应答。
“很好，”青帝微微一笑，右手拈如兰花，遥遥指向青龙，道：“那两个小儿刺瞎你的左眼，用的是借调雷霆之力的‘两仪电剑，。今夜我放开你后，既不需要雷霆，也不需要两人，只要一根手指，就能刺瞎你的右眼。你信也不信？”
青龙又是一阵狂吼，巨尾发疯似的凌空怒甩。
众人哄然大哗，似乎都没想到青帝竟要放开这好不容易才收伏的凶兽。
许宣心底更是一阵大凛，一根手指？当日多亏王重阳奋力拉起龙头，他与小青才侥幸刺伤那孽畜左眼。这“青帝”究竟有何神通，竟敢放此狂言，仅凭一根手指刺瞎青龙
青帝凌空踏步，衣衫猎猎鼓卷，凝立半空。左手抱琴，右手如兰花，曲于眉间，双眸灼灼地凝视着百丈开外的青龙，淡淡一笑：“孩儿们，还不放开它
飞骑军喧哗如沸，显然都极不情愿，但又不敢违背青帝意旨。面面相觑了一会儿，终于有人叫道：“斩除‘火蛛网，”零零落落地喷出几道水龙，朝壑中洒落。
过了片刻，飞骑军中又喷出几条水龙，接着此起彼伏，越来越多。水雾茫茫，浇落在裂壑与青龙的身上，闪现出万千道纵横交错的“金线”。被冷水喷洒，“哧哧”之声大作，“金线”纷纷断开。

许宣这才明白原来飞骑军在裂壑上方织满了奇特的“火蛛网”，虽不知“火蛛”为何物，但料想应是某种喜火怕水的罕见神蛛，吐出的蛛丝黏性极强，遇火收缩，更加强韧，将一头撞入网中的青龙牢牢缚住，直到此时被水雾浇洒，才逐一熔断。
蛛丝既断，再无可以捆缚青龙之物。那凶兽暴怒地咆哮着，翻腾旋甩，瞬间就将裂壑震出六七丈宽的豁口，冲天飞起。
飞骑军惊哗着四散逃开。青龙也不追击，径直怒吼着朝青帝冲去，巨口张处，一团直径约十丈的巨大火球飞旋破空，狂飙似的撞在他的身上。
惊呼迭起，许宣虽对这纵火烧灭蛇族的“青帝”满怀恨怒，见此情状，心中也猛然一紧。
“呼”地一声，青帝浑身烈焰喷舞，却依旧拈着兰花指，嘴角微笑，一动不动，直到青龙冲入十丈之距，才突然旋空冲起，指尖飞弹。“哧哧”激响，九道气箭连环没入青龙鳞甲，贯体破射而出。
那巨龙猛地一顿，发出惊怒痛楚的狂吼。伤口血丝喷舞，忽然冲出九条青藤，绕体极速蔓延，碧光闪耀。
“万壑春藤绕”许宣一震，突然想起程仲甫当年提过的一种上古木族法术。这种两伤法术虽能凝聚木灵，将对方贯体捆缚，但对自身伤害极大。黄帝统一五族之后，便已渐渐失传。想不到今日竟有缘在蓬莱亲眼目睹
青帝怀抱古琴，从它头顶翩然翻过，右手五指急速扫拂，琴声激奏，铿然急促如峭壁狂风、裂岸惊涛。绿藤随着琴声团团飞旋，越收越紧，转眼间就将青龙折为三叠，紧紧捆住。
三十三山飞骑欢呼如沸。
小青亦忍不住惊咦一声，想不到这青帝竟有如此神威难怪林灵素说“三十三山一山更比一山高”，原以为王重阳修为之强猛，已冠绝蓬莱，此刻看来仍远逊眼前之人。要想夺得“重阳比剑”的胜利，只怕真有些难于登天了
又听卡米道：“娘娘、圣上且看，青帝即将使出‘阴阳指，矣……”
话音未落，青帝浑身火焰忽然收入体内，碧光暴涨，冲入右手食指。“呼”指尖洇开一轮太极似的旋，而后倏然化为深翠浅绿两道螺旋光，朝青龙右眼刺去。
然而青龙之凶狂仍远远超出了所有人的预估。就在飞骑军欢腾鼓舞，以为胜券在握之际，它腾身舞爪，猛地朝外一挣，那层层叠叠的青藤竟然尽数迸断。继而鳞光卷舞，不等众人惊呼出声，已一头撞中青帝胸口
闪电飞舞，雷声轰鸣。天漏山烈焰燎原，炸涌起冲天红光。
在那漫天炽白、紫红的刺目光芒里，隐约可见那条碧光闪闪的巨龙咆哮着直冲苍穹。
青帝浑身着火，左手紧紧地握住龙角，双脚腾空，被它顶得东摇西摆，古琴尽碎，护体气罩已完全涣散。
飞骑军抬头齐望，一片死寂。
小青紧紧攥住许宣的手，掌心里尽是冷汗。她既希望这凶兽撞死青帝，为“重阳斗剑”扫除一个劲敌，又盼着青帝能毙杀青龙，以免他日自己再与这凶狂孽畜对决。
忽听青帝纵声清啸，脚尖在那巨龙的鼻隆上一点，左手握着龙角，翻身飞旋，右手“阴阳指”碧光怒卷，闪电般刺入青龙右眼。
“嗷——呜”青龙全身收蜷，吃痛狂吼。还不等反击，青帝又抓住它的犄角，凌空翻旋，将它猛然抛出十几丈远，惊哗声中，“阴阳指”旋怒舞，接连不断地撞向它的逆鳞与肚腹。

青龙双目俱盲，只能听风辨物，怎躲得过这迅雷狂飙似的连环猛击？一时间血箭“哧哧”，鳞甲飞炸，悲吼着团团乱舞。
三十三山飞骑欢呼如雷，鼓号齐奏，漫山遍野响彻着“青帝降龙，天下无敌，伏羲女娲，闻风避易”。
许宣听了越发怒火上冲，第一次与那青龙生出同仇敌忾之心，恨不能立即牵着小青冲将出去，双剑合璧，砍下青帝首级，为葬身壑底的王重阳兄妹与蛇人们报仇雪恨。
卡米似是知道他的心思，格格笑道：“圣上、娘娘无需担心，青帝‘阴阳指，之威力仅剩五成矣，必已被青龙撞伤经脉，至少要到下一次月圆之夜才能恢复也哉。小人虽本领低微，却对女帝山‘百花宫，了如指掌，只消圣上饶过小人这条贱命，小人必当肝脑涂地，以为向导。莫说找到白虎皮图，就算诛杀青帝，一举荡灭所有反贼，又有何难？”
：。：
content_en:
Xu Xuan was furious when he heard this, and laughed loudly: "How dare you design Feng Qingxuan to set Tianluo Mountain on fire, just to overthrow the 'Qing Emperor' and restore the rule of the gods?"
Kami hurriedly said: "The Holy Spirit has made it clear that the alliance between the villain and Feng Qingxuan is true, but Feng Qingxuan is very loyal to the Gods. If I hadn't been devoted to the Gods, how could Feng Qingxuan be able to support each other with life and death?" ? The reason why I killed him just now was because Tianlu Mountain was burned by the Qing Emperor, and I was afraid that he would be angry with me, so I was forced to take action first. However, burning Tianlu Mountain was not the idea of a villain, but the order of the Qing Emperor's new concubine.
"After that bitch came to Penglai, relying on the Qing Emperor's favor and trust, he exercised arbitrary power and acted recklessly. Anyone who dared to disobey would have his head chopped off immediately. He also used monstrous words to confuse the public, and persuaded the Qing Emperor to leave Penglai every day, sweeping the world and unifying the world. Hey, no one in the Thirty-three Mountains dares to be angry or speak out. They only hope that they can compete with swords on the Double Ninth Festival, elect a new Qing Emperor, and escape from the sea of suffering..."
Xiao Qing said with a smile: "That's right, you stayed in Penglai just to find that 'White Tiger Skin Picture'. It's a pity that as soon as the Qing Emperor's new favorite comes, your divine wish will lose its power, and all your wishful thinking will come to nothing. So you hold a grudge and want to collude with the loyal ministers of the Thirty-three Mountains to overthrow the Qing Emperor during the Double Ninth Festival. But to overthrow the Qing Emperor, force alone is not enough, we also need people, so we tricked Feng Qingxuan into sending us into your hands... Hum, even the reincarnations of Fuxi and Nuwa were captured alive by you, how dare Thirty-Three Mountains not to worship you as the Qing Emperor? "
Kami didn't expect that she was so smart and could see through him at a glance. A trace of embarrassment flashed across her face, and she argued forcefully: "My dear, you are wronged. This villain is loyal and courageous, and everything he does is to restore the rule of the God Clan. Since Feng Qingxuan doesn't believe that you are the real reincarnation of the Snake Emperor, I am naturally a little doubtful. However, I think about it, there is a Chinese proverb, 'It is a mule or a horse, pull it out and run around. If it is true, I will die in service..."
"Fart!" Xiaoqing's pretty face sank, "Who do you think is the mule and who is the horse? "
Xu Xuan was furious at this moment and had no time to chat with the cunning old man. He grabbed the "Purple Dragon Sword" and placed it on the other side of his neck, shouting: "If you stop talking nonsense and tell the whereabouts of the 'White Tiger Skin Picture', I will cut off your head to commemorate the spirit of the snake clan brothers in heaven."
Kami trembled with fright and said with a grimace: "Hey, if the villain tells the Holy One and the Empress now, the Holy Majesty and the Empress will immediately chop the villain into meat paste. It's better to wait for the villain to take the two of you to the Baihua Palace in person, and present the "White Tiger Skin Picture" with both hands, and then the Holy Master and the Empress will treat the villain as a fart and let it go. Really?
Xiao Qing was angry and funny. Just as he was about to speak, he suddenly heard the roar of the green dragon and the "boom boom" earthquakes. The glacier under his feet quickly collapsed again, and layers of snow waves surged above, rolling down the steep wall. He hurriedly picked up Kami, jumped onto the dragon vulture with Xu Xuan, and flew into the sky.
The green dragon was covered in purple and red, struggling crazily in the sea of ​​fire. Every time it struggled, dozens of cracks burst out on both sides of the valley. The flying cavalry troops hovering above kept exclaiming. They didn't expect that this evil beast was so stubborn and had been burned by the magma fire for so long, but it could still be so ferocious.
"Dang" a golden gong sounded, the drum music was full, and the flying cavalry army fell silent instantly.
Qingdi stood up and said calmly: "Brother Qinglong, I heard that during the last full moon, one of your eyes was injured by two infants. If I stuck you like this tonight and blinded your other eye, you would definitely be unconvinced and blame me for my lack of force, right?"
Qinglong roared, seeming to respond angrily.
"Very good," Qing Emperor smiled slightly, holding his right hand like an orchid, pointing at Qinglong from a distance, and said: "The two children who blinded your left eye used the 'Liangyi Electric Sword' that borrowed the power of thunder. After I let you go tonight, I don't need either thunder or two people, just one finger can blind your right eye.. Do you believe it or not? "
The green dragon roared wildly again, and swung its giant tail in the air like crazy.
Everyone was in an uproar, as if they didn't expect Qing Emperor to let go of the ferocious beast that he had finally subdued.
许宣心底更是一阵大凛，一根手指？ Thanks to Wang Chongyang's efforts to pull up the faucet that day, he and Xiao Qing were lucky enough to stab the evil beast in the left eye. What kind of magical power does this "Qing Emperor" have? He dares to make such wild claims and blind Qinglong with just one finger.
The Qing Emperor stepped in the air, his clothes were curled up, and he stood in mid-air. Holding the piano in his left hand, his right hand is like an orchid, curled between his eyebrows. He stared at the green dragon a hundred feet away with burning eyes, and smiled faintly: "Children, don't let it go yet."
The flying cavalry army was noisy, obviously very reluctant, but they did not dare to go against the Qing Emperor's will. After looking at each other for a while, someone finally shouted: "Cut away the fire spider web," and a few water dragons sprayed out scatteredly into the ravine.
After a while, several more water dragons spewed out from the flying cavalry army, and then one after another, more and more water dragons were sprayed out. The mist of water fell on the bodies of Li He and Qing Long, and thousands of crisscrossing "golden threads" flashed out. Being sprayed with cold water, the sound of "chichi" was loud, and the "golden threads" were disconnected one after another.
Only then did Xu Xuan realize that the Flying Cavalry Army had woven a strange "fire spider web" all over the ravine. Although he didn't know what the "fire spider" was, he expected it to be some kind of rare divine spider that loved fire and was afraid of water. The spider silk it spewed was extremely sticky and shrank when exposed to fire, making it even stronger.
蛛丝既断，再无可以捆缚青龙之物。 The ferocious beast roared angrily, rolled and swung around, and instantly opened a gap six to seven feet wide in the chasm, and flew into the sky.
飞骑军惊哗着四散逃开。 Qinglong did not pursue him, but roared and rushed towards Qingdi. With its huge mouth open, a huge fireball about ten feet in diameter flew through the air and hit him like a hurricane.
There were exclamations one after another. Although Xu Xuan was full of hatred for the "Qing Emperor" who set fire to the snake clan, his heart suddenly tightened when he saw this situation.
With a "whoop", the Qing Emperor was covered in flames, but he still held the orchid finger, smiled at the corner of his mouth, and remained motionless until the Qing Dragon rushed into the distance of ten feet, and then suddenly spun into the air and flew with his fingertips. With a "chichi" sound, nine air arrows sank into the blue dragon's scale armor and shot out through the body.
The giant dragon suddenly froze and let out a roar of fright, anger and pain. Bloodshot threads danced from the wound, and nine ivy branches suddenly shot out, spreading around the body at an extremely fast speed, and green light shone.
"Ten thousand valleys are surrounded by ivy." Xu Xuan was shocked and suddenly remembered an ancient wood clan spell that Cheng Zhongfu mentioned back then. Although this kind of two-damage spell can condense the wood spirit and bind the opponent's body, it will cause great harm to oneself.黄帝统一五族之后，便已渐渐失传。想不到今日竟有缘在蓬莱亲眼目睹
The Qing Emperor holds the guqin in his arms and flips it over the top of his head. He sweeps the five fingers of his right hand rapidly, and the sound of the qin is vigorous and rapid, like a strong wind on a cliff or a breaking wave on a shore. The green vines whirled around in time with the sound of the piano, tightening tighter and tighter. In the blink of an eye, the green dragon was folded into three folds and tied tightly.
三十三山飞骑欢呼如沸。
Xiao Qing couldn't help but exclaimed, she didn't expect that the Qing Emperor could be so powerful. No wonder Lin Lingsu said, "Thirty-three mountains are higher than each other." She originally thought that Wang Chongyang's cultivation was so powerful that it would surpass Penglai, but now it seems that he is still far inferior to the person in front of him. If you want to win the "Double Ninth Festival Sword Competition", I'm afraid it will be really difficult to reach the sky.
He then heard Kami say: "Your Majesty, your Majesty, wait and see, Emperor Qing is about to use his 'yin and yang finger'..."
Before he finished speaking, the Qing Emperor's whole body was suddenly filled with flames, and the green light surged into his right index finger. "Hu" the fingertips spread out a Tai Chi-like spin, and then suddenly turned into two spiral lights of dark emerald and light green, stabbing towards Qinglong's right eye.
However, the ferocity of Qinglong still far exceeded everyone's expectations. Just when the flying cavalry army was cheering and thinking that they had a chance to win, it jumped up and danced its claws, and suddenly struggled outwards.All the stacks of green vines suddenly broke. Then the scales danced, and before everyone could scream in surprise, they hit Qingdi's chest with his head.
Lightning flashed and thunder roared. The fierce flames of Tianlu Mountain set the prairie fire on fire, and the explosion surged into the sky with red light.
In the dazzling white and purple light that filled the sky, one could vaguely see the gleaming green dragon roaring straight into the sky.
Qing Di was on fire. He held the dragon horn tightly with his left hand and his feet were in the air. He was rocked by it, his guqin was shattered, and his protective aura was completely dispersed.
The flying cavalry army raised their heads and looked at each other, and there was dead silence.
Xiaoqing held Xu Xuan's hand tightly, her palms filled with cold sweat. She not only hoped that the ferocious beast would kill the Qing Emperor and eliminate a powerful enemy for the "Chongyang Sword Fight", but she also hoped that the Qing Emperor could kill the Qing Long to avoid another duel with this ferocious beast in the future.
Suddenly, he heard the Qing Emperor roaring loudly. He put his toes a little on the dragon's nose, held the dragon's horn in his left hand, turned over and whirled around, and the green light from the "yin and yang finger" of his right hand rolled out, piercing the Qinglong's right eye like lightning.
"Ouch - ow" Qinglong curled up and roared in pain. Before it could counterattack, Qingdi grabbed its horns again, spun it in the air, and suddenly threw it more than ten feet away. Amid the startling sound, the "yin and yang fingers" danced angrily, hitting its back scales and belly one after another.
Qinglong was blind and could only distinguish objects by listening to the wind. How could he avoid this series of rapid and violent attacks? For a moment, the blood arrows "chichi", the scales exploded, and they danced around with a sad roar.
The flying cavalry of Thirty-three Mountains cheered like thunder, drums and trumpets played in unison, and the words "The Green Emperor descends the dragon, the world is invincible, Fuxi and Nuwa, hear the wind and avoid troubles" can be heard all over the mountains and plains.
When Xu Xuan heard this, he became even more angry. For the first time, he felt the same hatred as the Qinglong. He wished he could lead Xiao Qing and rush out immediately.
